To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the process of building and using information systems should be contingent, in terms of the systems development process, on the characteristics of real world system which are to be transformed with use of information technology.
the process of building and deploying information systems is contingent on the nature of the real world systems that the information system is designed to support.

the contingency approach to information systems development is a useful approach, and that the approach is particularly useful when the systems being developed have a low level of stability and a high level of knowability and predictability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a contingency approach to the systems development process.
the development of a contingency theory of systems development.
the process of systems development and implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the contingency based approach is the best method for the systems analysis and development.
a contingency based approach to information system development should be adopted.
there are many types of systems and that there is no single best way of building and implementing information systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a contingency based approach to systems development is necessary, and that the contingency is the real world system.
the contingency approach to information systems development should be based on the real world characteristics of the system to be transformed with information technology.
the process of requirements elicitation is a critical factor in the success of an information system development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contingency approach is not only applicable to systems development, but also to the requirements elicitation and analysis processes.
there is no single best way to develop an information system.
the contingency based approach to systems development can be applied to the development of information systems.
